events.action:
{"message": "Fixed the integer overflow bug in `z_thread_stack_alloc_dyn` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/kernel/dynamic.c`.

### Cause
When allocating a kernel thread stack dynamically via `k_thread_stack_alloc(size, 0)` with a very large `size` (such as `SIZE_MAX`), `K_KERNEL_STACK_LEN(size)` rounds up and adds `K_KERNEL_STACK_RESERVED`, wrapping around `size_t` to a small value. `z_thread_aligned_alloc` then succeeded with a small allocation instead of failing.

### Fix
Checked whether the adjusted stack size `K_KERNEL_STACK_LEN(size)` wrapped around (`adjusted_size < size`) in `z_thread_stack_alloc_dyn`, returning `NULL` if an overflow occurred.", "kind": "FinishAction"}

{"content": [{"cache_prompt": false, "type": "text", "text": "Fixed the integer overflow bug in `z_thread_stack_alloc_dyn` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/kernel/dynamic.c`.

### Cause
When allocating a kernel thread stack dynamically via `k_thread_stack_alloc(size, 0)` with a very large `size` (such as `SIZE_MAX`), `K_KERNEL_STACK_LEN(size)` rounds up and adds `K_KERNEL_STACK_RESERVED`, wrapping around `size_t` to a small value. `z_thread_aligned_alloc` then succeeded with a small allocation instead of failing.

### Fix
Checked whether the adjusted stack size `K_KERNEL_STACK_LEN(size)` wrapped around (`adjusted_size < size`) in `z_thread_stack_alloc_dyn`, returning `NULL` if an overflow occurred."}], "is_error": false, "kind": "FinishObservation"}
